text:
Alex: heads-up — i'm prototyping a tiny dashboard (working name: QueueWatch) to surface continuous-batcher health: batch_util_pct, avg_queue_depth, tokens_per_sec, kv_cache_hitrate, and kernel_choice breakdown. need a minimal event set + labels we can hook from runtime. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Alex: quick profiler snapshot from the regression run (p50/p95 in ms, simple counts):
```
kernel_select: aten_fp16: 482k (p50 0.9ms, p95 3.2ms)
kernel_select: fused_attn_v2: 120k (p50 0.6ms, p95 5.8ms)
kv_cache: hits=1.3M misses=240k hit_rate=84%
batch: avg_size=6.1 queue_wait_ms_p95=240
token_throughput=1.9k/sec
```

Morgan: nice. couple of asks: what sampling rate can we tolerate for per-batch traces? and retention? for dashboards i want seq_len_bucket + model_family + priority_lane as labels.

Ravi: agree with labels. also add token_budget_target and flow_policy label (eg conservative vs aggressive). we should emit an event when batch formation aborts due to token_budget_hit so we can correlate drops. example metric names: `batcher_batch_size{model_family,seq_len_bucket}`, `batcher_queue_time_ms`, `batcher_tokens_in_batch`, `batcher_token_budget_used_pct`.

Sasha: UI thoughts: panels = 1) real-time tokens/sec (1m/5m), 2) stacked area kernel_choice % over time, 3) heatmap avg_queue_depth by priority_lane x seq_len_bucket, 4) rolling 1h kv_cache_hitrate and kv_miss_rate, 5) p95 queue_wait_ms trend. add an alert if queue_wait_ms_p95 > 500ms for >5min or tokens/sec drops 20% vs baseline. :rotating_light:

Jenn: i can stub the grafana dashboard. what exact prometheus/generic metric names do you want me to wire? i can start with a minimal set.

Alex: minimal emit set to start (string names we can map from runtime):
- `batcher.batch_utilization_percent` (gauge) labels: model_family, seq_len_bucket, priority_lane, kernel_hint
- `batcher.avg_queue_depth` (gauge) labels: model_family, priority_lane
- `batcher.tokens_per_second` (gauge) labels: model_family, region
- `batcher.kv_hit` / `batcher.kv_miss` (counter) labels: model_family, kv_region
- `batcher.kernel_choice_count` (counter) labels: kernel_name, model_family
- `batcher.token_budget_pct` (gauge) labels: flow_policy, priority_lane
- `batcher.batch_formation_abort` (counter) labels: reason, model_family, priority_lane

Alex: keep per-batch traces sampled at 0.2% to start (and spike-capture at higher rates when queue_wait_ms_p95 crosses 300ms). retention: 7d for traces, 90d for aggregated metrics.

Morgan: +1. For cost reasons, roll up kernel_choice_count into 1m buckets and only keep raw per-batch IDs when we sample.

Ravi: example alert pseudo-query: `sum(rate(batcher.tokens_per_second[5m])) by (model_family) < 0.8 * baseline_tokens_family` — emit ticket with `batch_ids` when fired. we need a lightweight way to attach last 10 batch_ids to alerts.

Sasha: add a dashboard panel that shows recent regression markers (manual flagging) so infra/research can annotate timelines (kernel rollouts, quant changes).

ci-bot: deploy: batcher-telemetry/prototype v0.2 -> staging by jenn at 2026-03-18T12:23:11Z :white_check_mark:

Jenn: created initial grafana JSON with panels for tokens/sec, kernel_choice stacked area, and kv_hitrate. PR in `infra/observability` -> opening now. ping me if you want panel names changed.

ops-bot: incident-log: reference #INC-2026-114 linked — queue_wait_ms spike (2026-03-17) correlated with kernel pivot. https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-114

Alex: perfect. next steps: jenn + morgan to land dashboard stub, ravi + sasha to define alert runbooks, i'll add runtime emitters for the metric names above. sync Friday 10am PT. :raised_hands:

Morgan: i'll add seq_len_bucket logic to sampling and a small renderer for the heatmap.

Ravi: will draft the alert -> playbook mapping and add automation to attach last-batch-ids.

Sasha: i'll prepare a short demo gif for the all-hands if we have a stable snapshot by Friday.

Alex: thanks all — moving this to `eng-runtime` board and assigning follow-ups. :eyes:
